Truecaller CEO Warns of Rising Spam Calls

The CEO of Truecaller has warned that spam calls are not over yet and will continue to rise. The company reported that over 51 million calls from the 140 and 1600 series go unanswered every day. This has led to a directive from TRAI to stop displaying spam labels on calls originating from these number series.
